title: Your Money Can’t Save You From This Judgment! #bible #truth #christianresponse
cleanTitle: Your Money Can’t Save You From This Judgment!
segments: Jay-Z is the richest musician in the
world. $2.5 billion empire. If Jay-Z
gets sick, he goes to a white hospital.
A homeless black man on the streets of
Atlanta has nowhere to live, nowhere to
sleep. He gets sick, he goes to a white
hospital.  LeBron James is a
billionaire.
When he need groceries for his family,
he go to a white supermarket. When I
need groceries for my family, I go to a
white supermarket. I want you to see how
from the richest black in America
to the poorest black in America, we are
all still dependent on white
institutions and systems. Think about
that. Even the rich blacks haven't
come together to create a rich
infrastructure, even if it's just for
them, right? Let's say LeBron, Jay-Z,
Oprah, Rihanna,
Venus, Tiger Woods, they all get
together and say, "Listen, for us and
our kids, we going  to create a
black Wall Street, a small one just for
us." They haven't even done that. They
are at mercy as  much as we are
for white people's systems and
institutions and immigrants.
